dimensions: bo 10, be 100. (my meas: mp rcvr 11.5, slide exit 10.1 (tenon may be new repair—solder repair visible where tenon joins main sec.), slide sec. 1593, bell sec. 1052, overlap 19, total le 2666; bo1 10, bo2 9.1/10.3 (damage), be 103/104; garland 23 axial, 28 on surface of bell.
remarks: Very similar to other Geyer 1676 tenor—shoft reffurle**** of asc. tube, just below immoveable stay, has decorations unlike 16761. Both slide stays show repair: on both, only the upper portion of the original remains; moveable slide stay telescopic. 4 patches on asc. slide tube, small dents on inner slide; slide bow has saddle with very large wire ring—perhaps later repair; ferrules match on both instruments, though some may be later repairs; 2 inner slides tubes are different lengths; each has joint in middle, the result of repair. one flat bell stay, identical to 16761, except for ornament on proximal surface above letters “MAR”. Joint in bell sec. as in 16761. Saddle and ring in bell-bow; ring here is a bit smaller than 16761. Four brass patches on bell. Garland identical to 16761; dent in bell has caused garland to detach from bell in some spots. Small brass tab attached to rim wire; toothed seam in bell at 3 o’clock. Floral pattern on bell very similar but not identical to 16761.**** Examined by author, June 1999.
